messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary rollout (encoder-service v2) failing — 3/5 canary pods CrashLoopBackOff, 500s spike on /v1/infer. HPA observed scaling to 0 replicas in some zones. Pager triggered.
bob-oncall: Oncall here, paging in. Investigating. PD: PD-98765.
alice-sre: joining. Can you paste recent deploy commit/PR?
carla-eng: PR #1482 merged ~2m ago — changed readiness probe from `/health` -> `/ready` and removed a liveness check (was flaky). Small manifest change: `readinessProbe: httpGet /ready` only.
dave-product: any idea on customer impact? Seen any support tickets?
erin-support: AcmeCorp reported 503s to /v1/infer ~2:03pm UTC, internal ticket INC-4321. One more customer reported timeouts.
alice-sre: looking at metrics: error rate ~12% on encoder route, latency doubled. Control plane logs show several pods failing readiness then HPA scaled down due to low CPU samples (weird).
frank-infra: We're running a scheduled node drain in eu-west-1 for kernel patching — some pods got moved. Combined with the new readiness path, pods fail to become Ready during graceful termination -> HPA sees low usage and scaled replicas down to 0 in that AZ.
bob-oncall: Action plan: 1) Prevent further drain-induced evictions 2) Patch HPA to minReplicas=2 3) Rollback the readiness change if needed. Agree?
carla-eng: +1 on rollback; readiness path change is the least risky. I'll prepare a quick revert to `encoder:v1.14.3` (previous working image).
frank-infra: I've paused the node drain job (will abort remaining cordons). Uncordoning node-17 now.
bob-oncall: Patching HPA minReplicas -> 2 to stop immediate scale-to-zero. Executing:
```
kubectl patch hpa encoder -n inference --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'
```
(alice-sre, confirm?)
alice-sre: Confirmed patch applied in eu-west-1 and us-east-1. HPA will respect minReplicas now.
bob-oncall: Initiating rollback of canary image to v1.14.3:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/encoder encoder=ghcr.io/redwood/encoder:v1.14.3 --record
kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/encoder
```
carla-eng: Revert PR branch created and hotfix image built. Approving immediate rollback.
incident-bot: Deployment rollback initiated by bob-oncall.
dave-product: I'll draft a customer-facing blurb: short apology, mitigation in progress, ETA 15-30m. Erin, can you send to AcmeCorp?
erin-support: Message sent to AcmeCorp & affected accounts. Internal status page updated.
frank-infra: Node-17 uncordoned, pods rescheduling — I see 2 new encoder pods reaching Ready.
bob-oncall: Rollout status: 5/5 encoder pods Ready. CrashLoopBackOff count dropping. Health checks green.
alice-sre: Observability check: error rate back to baseline, latency reduced to normal. Will keep monitoring 30m.
carla-eng: I'll open follow-up: add e2e for readiness path and add a pre-rollout check that simulates node drain + readiness transitions. Ticket: INF-7890.
dave-product: Postmortem owners? Alice + Carla + Frank. We'll classify this as P2 with customer impact but no data loss.
incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated. Timeline and notes to be posted in #postmortems. Closing page in 1h if stable. :white_check_mark:
